# T-4: Unify review exclusions

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add `flow.review.excludePaths` and route default exclusions plus config exclusions through one matcher before impl-review target counting and diff collection.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R9 passes for touched file count, per-file diff collection, and loop chunk creation.
- Default exclusions and config exclusions use the same repository-root-relative matching function.
- No project-specific path is hardcoded under `src/`.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing config loading and path matching helpers where possible. Replace direct `REVIEW_EXCLUDE_PATHS.some((ex) => f.startsWith(ex))` checks with one exclusion decision helper.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests with `// spec: R9 ...` headers configure `flow.review.excludePaths` and assert excluded files do not contribute to loop threshold, per-file diffs, or chunks. Shared unit tests may cover matcher behavior.
